_comment: ORGANISER ONLY. How Submission 1 (graph reconstruction) edges are classified. Reference edges are derived automatically from VERIFIED paper-to-paper edges in master_graph.json; this file adds the neutral set and the false-edge classes. All identifiers are participant IDs.

hidden_pairs._comment: Any relationship between base and target is neutral (neither TP nor FP), so the iterative scorer cannot be used as an oracle for the hidden connection.

neutral_rules.description: Conceptual / interpretive links among papers that genuinely address hidden-tree reconstruction or its survey are defensible even when no single passage states them. Neutral unless already a reference edge.
Chow-Liu, latent-tree learning and ARACNE share a mutual-information / dependence-tree foundation.
Network tomography and sparse recovery are all indirect-measurement inverse problems. Defensible as ANALOGOUS_PROBLEM, but not the hidden-tree principle.

ordinary_rejected_from_master: Paper-to-paper edges marked REJECTED in master_graph.json with false_edge_class 'ordinary' (e.g. P08 USES_METHOD P03) are listed for documentation; they score as ordinary false positives.
review_queue: Any false-positive edge submitted with a non-empty evidence_reference is copied to the organiser review queue. Promoted edges join the reference set via data/submissions/accepted_additions.json and teams are rescored.
